request.prompt: Make a surgical texture-only correction to this existing Orange Pets hedgehog brown coat. The head has two correct front-facing black bead eyes PLUS two erroneous duplicate eye pixels on its side faces, making it look four-eyed. Fix their spacing too: the 8-pixel-wide north face currently has eyes at local columns 2 and 7, which is asymmetric. Keep the front eye at atlas (20,24) and move the other eye from (25,24) to (23,24), giving symmetric local columns 2 and 5. Remove only the two extra side eye marks by restoring the surrounding face fur colour/shading. Do not add eyes, highlights, outlines, new colours, patches or new geometry. The light_face cube has uv [0,18], w=8,h=4,d=5. Its front/north face is atlas x18..25 y23..26, containing the existing asymmetrically spaced eye pixels at (20,24) and (25,24). Erroneous side eye commands are rect (4,24,1,1) and rect (13,24,1,1), colour #191716. Remove the two side-eye commands and change only x=25 to x=23 on the front-eye command. This must change exactly four atlas pixels: (4,24),(13,24),(23,24),(25,24). Preserve all other drawing commands in their existing order. Nose pixels at x46..51 must remain intact. Preserve texture dimensions, palette, coat colours, all other pixels, every element coordinate/name/UV, bones, mob settings and ALL animations exactly. This is a correction to an existing generated design, not a redesign. Use preserve mode for all animation clips.
